cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Phones, computers and the internet; screens show simple pictures or a smiling face, never readable writing.

words.en: When you get home, give somebody a call.
words.sz: 你到家后给人打个电话。
words.scene: Lily talking happily on a phone, sitting on the sofa, Grandma smiling on the screen of the phone in a little bubble.
more: I'll give somebody a call for help.
我会打电话找人帮忙。
If you are lost, give somebody a call.
如果你迷路了，就给人打个电话。

words.en: Mia's email is mia at home dot net.
words.scene: A big black @ symbol on a laptop screen, Lily typing on the keyboard.
more: Sam's email has at after his name.
Sam 的邮箱地址里，名字后面是 @。
Sam writes at in his email.
Sam 在他的邮箱里写了 at。

words.en: The website ends with dot net.
words.sz: 这个网站以 dot net 结尾。
words.scene: A big round blue dot on a white background.
more: Put a dot after the word.
在单词后加一个点。
I see a small dot on the screen.
我在屏幕上看到一个小圆点。

words.en: Click the picture to start.
words.scene: Lily's finger clicking a computer mouse, a cursor on the screen.
more: Please click here, Tom.
Tom，请点击这里。
I hear a click on the keyboard.
我听到键盘的点击声。

words.en: Lily and Mia chat on the phone.
words.sz: Lily 和 Mia 在手机上聊天。
words.scene: Lily and Mia sitting on a bench, talking and laughing, holding phones.
more: We have a short chat.
我们简短地聊了一会儿。
Mum chats with her friend.
妈妈和她的朋友聊天。

words.en: Grandma and Mum have a long conversation.
words.sz: 奶奶和妈妈进行了长谈。
words.scene: Grandma and Mum sitting at a table, drinking tea, talking to each other.
more: This is an interesting conversation.
这是一个有趣的对话。
Dad listens to the conversation.
爸爸听着这个谈话。

words.en: I download a new game.
words.scene: Tom sitting on the sofa with a tablet, watching a coloured bar fill up slowly on the screen, waiting for a new game.
more: Tom wants to download a film.
Tom 想下载一部电影。
The download is very fast.
这个下载速度很快。

words.en: Dad sends an email to work.
words.sz: 爸爸给公司发了一封电子邮件。
words.scene: Mum sitting at her office desk in front of an open laptop, a big empty envelope floating above the screen, no writing anywhere on the screen, a cup beside her hand.
more: I read my email every morning.
我每天早上读电子邮件。
Please email me the photo.
请把照片发电子邮件给我。

words.en: Put the letter in an envelope.
words.scene: Lily folding a letter and putting it into a white envelope at the kitchen table, a stamp ready beside her.
more: Grandma writes on an envelope.
奶奶在信封上写字。
This envelope is blue and big.
这个信封是蓝色的，很大。

words.en: Save the file on the computer.
words.scene: Dad at a computer desk clicking the mouse, on the screen a yellow folder picture and a picture of a photo; no writing on the screen.
more: I have a new file for school.
我有一个新的学校文件。
Where is the photo file?
照片文件在哪里？

words.en: We use the internet at home.
words.scene: A globe with lines connecting computers and phones around it.
more: The internet is very useful.
互联网非常有用。
Tom looks for games on the internet.
Tom 在互联网上找游戏。

words.en: I play games on the net.
words.scene: A laptop with a big glowing globe above it, representing the net.
more: Find the answer on the net.
在网上找到答案。
The net is slow today.
今天网速很慢。

words.en: Lily has an online lesson.
words.scene: Lily having an online lesson, her teacher smiling on the laptop screen.
more: We watch a film online.
我们在网上看电影。
Is your homework online?
你的作业是在线上的吗？

words.en: Remember your password.
words.scene: Lily covering a laptop keyboard with one hand, a little padlock on the screen.
more: Dad types his password.
爸爸输入他的密码。
The password is long and hard.
这个密码很长很难。

words.en: I type on the keyboard.
words.scene: Dad's hands typing on a black computer keyboard on a desk, a mug of coffee beside it, seen from above.
more: The keyboard has many letters.
键盘有很多字母。
Tom cleans the keyboard.
Tom 清洁键盘。

words.en: Click the mouse to move.
more: The mouse is next to the keyboard.
鼠标在键盘旁边。
I need a new computer mouse.
我需要一个新的电脑鼠标。

words.en: Dad uses the printer at work.
words.sz: 爸爸在工作时使用打印机。
words.scene: A grey office printer on a desk with a sheet of paper half out showing a picture of a big red apple; nobody in the picture.
more: The printer is very loud.
打印机很吵。
Please print my homework.
请打印我的作业。

words.en: Look at the big screen.
words.scene: A big bright computer screen showing a sunny beach.
more: The phone screen is dirty.
手机屏幕脏了。
Turn off the screen, please.
请关闭屏幕。

words.en: We need new software.
words.scene: Sam installing a game on a computer, a loading bar on the screen.
more: This software is free.
这个软件是免费的。
Dad buys good software.
爸爸买好的软件。

words.en: Tom draws on a tablet.
words.sz: Tom 在平板电脑上画画。
words.scene: Tom drawing on a tablet with his finger, smiling.
more: I read books on my tablet.
我在我的平板电脑上看书。
The tablet screen is bright.
平板电脑的屏幕很亮。

words.en: Mia sends a text to Lily.
words.sz: Mia 给 Lily 发了一条短信。
words.scene: Mia typing a text on her phone, a heart in the message bubble.
more: Read the text on your phone.
读你手机上的文字。
Please text me later.
请稍后发短信给我。

words.en: Lily looks at the web for homework.
words.scene: Lily and Mum sitting at a laptop looking at pictures of dolphins on the screen, Lily pointing; no writing on the screen.
more: The web has lots of pictures.
网上有很多图片。
Dad uses the web at work.
爸爸工作的时候上网。

words.en: Lily reads a web page about dogs.
words.sz: Lily 读一个关于狗的网页。
words.scene: a laptop showing a colourful web page about dogs (pictures only).
more: This web page is interesting.
这个网页很有趣。
Tom likes the web page with cats.
Tom 喜欢那个有猫的网页。

words.en: Mum and Lily look at a website.
words.sz: 妈妈和 Lily 看一个网站。
words.scene: Lily and Mum looking at a website about holidays on a computer.
more: Our school has a new website.
我们的学校有一个新网站。
This website is for children.
这个网站是给小朋友看的。

words.en: Lily has a digital watch.
words.scene: Lily's wrist with a blue digital watch with a small square screen showing glowing digits, next to Grandpa's wrist with an old round watch with hands.
more: Dad uses a digital camera.
爸爸用数码相机拍照。
The clock on the wall is digital.
墙上的钟是电子的。

words.en: Lily gets information from the web.
more: The website has good information.
这个网站有很好的信息。
Tom asks for information about birds.
Tom 询问关于鸟的信息。

words.en: Lily sends the card by post.
words.scene: Lily posting a parcel into a red post box.
more: Grandma gets letters by post.
奶奶通过邮寄收到信。
We buy books by post sometimes.
我们有时通过邮寄买书。

words.en: Grandma calls Lily on the phone.
words.sz: 奶奶给 Lily 打电话。
words.scene: Grandma calling on the phone, Lily answering.
more: I have a call from Mia.
我接到 Mia 的电话。
Please call me tonight.
请今晚给我打电话。

words.en: Tom talks to Grandpa in the garden.
words.sz: Tom 在花园里和爷爷说话。
words.scene: Tom and Grandpa talking in the garden.
more: Lily and Mia talk on the phone.
Lily 和 Mia 在电话里聊天。
We have a nice talk at lunch.
午饭时我们聊得很开心。

words.en: Sam likes photography very much.
words.scene: Sam with a big camera on a stand photographing flowers.
more: Photography is Sam's hobby.
摄影是 Sam 的爱好。
Mia learns about photography at school.
Mia 在学校学习摄影。

words.en: Lily writes her address on the letter.
words.sz: Lily 在信上写上她的地址。
more: What is your email address?
你的电子邮箱地址是什么？
Tom knows his home address.
Tom 知道他家的地址。

words.en: Dad takes a photo with his camera.
words.sz: 爸爸用他的照相机拍照。
words.scene: One black camera with a big round lens standing on a table, its flash on top and a strap lying beside it.
more: Lily wants to use the camera.
Lily 想用照相机。
The camera is in the bag.
照相机在包里。

words.en: Lily listens to a music CD.
words.scene: Lily holding one shiny round silver disc with a hole in the middle up to the light, rainbow colours on it, its thin square plastic case open in her other hand.
more: This CD has funny songs.
这张 CD 有有趣的歌。
Tom puts the CD in the player.
Tom 把 CD 放进播放机。

words.en: Dad plays the CD on the player.
words.scene: One silver CD player on a wooden shelf with its round tray open and a shiny disc in it, two small loudspeakers beside it.
more: The CD player is very old.
这个 CD 播放机很旧了。
Lily turns on the CD player.
Lily 打开 CD 播放机。

words.en: Mia talks on her cell phone.
words.scene: Mia holding a smartphone, a video call with Grandma on its screen.
more: Lily sees Mia's cell phone.
Lily 看见 Mia 的手机。
Please don't use your cell phone at dinner.
吃饭时请不要用手机。

words.en: Lily draws on the computer.
more: Mum checks her email on the computer.
妈妈在电脑上看电子邮件。
Tom plays a game on the computer.
Tom 在电脑上玩游戏。

words.en: Sam takes a photo with his digital camera.
words.sz: Sam 用他的数码相机拍照。
words.scene: Sam taking a picture with a small silver digital camera.
more: My digital camera is small.
我的数码相机很小。
Lily likes the photos from the digital camera.
Lily 喜欢数码相机拍的照片。

words.en: We watch a funny DVD.
words.sz: 我们看一张有趣的 DVD。
more: Lily puts the DVD in the box.
Lily 把 DVD 放进盒子里。
This DVD is about sea animals.
这张 DVD 是关于海洋动物的。

words.en: Tom puts the DVD in the player.
words.sz: Tom 把 DVD 放进播放机。
more: The DVD player is on the table.
DVD 播放机在桌子上。
Dad turns on the DVD player.
爸爸打开 DVD 播放机。

words.en: Lily does homework on her laptop.
words.sz: Lily 在她的笔记本电脑上做作业。
words.scene: an open laptop on a kitchen table, Lily typing on it.
more: Mum carries the laptop to work.
妈妈把笔记本电脑带去上班。
The laptop is very light.
这台笔记本电脑很轻。

words.en: Dad talks on his mobile.
words.scene: Dad talking on his mobile phone as he walks in the street.
more: Lily calls Mia on her mobile.
Lily 用手机给 Mia 打电话。
Tom sees Dad's old mobile.
Tom 看见爸爸的旧手机。

words.en: Lily uses the PC for school.
words.sz: Lily 用个人电脑做学校的功课。
words.scene: a desktop PC with a big monitor, keyboard and mouse on a desk.
more: The PC is in Dad's office.
个人电脑在爸爸的书房里。
Tom plays a game on the PC.
Tom 在个人电脑上玩游戏。

words.en: Lily answers the phone.
words.scene: Lily on the sofa holding a phone to her ear, smiling.
more: Mum calls Grandma on the phone.
妈妈用电话给奶奶打电话。
Tom drops his toy phone.
Tom 把玩具手机掉在地上。

words.en: Lily looks at the family photo.
words.scene: Mum holding up one big photo of a small puppy on the grass, Lily and Tom beside her pointing at it and laughing.
more: Dad takes a photo of Max.
爸爸给 Max 拍了一张照片。
This photo is from Grandma.
这张照片是奶奶寄来的。

words.en: The telephone rings in the hall.
words.scene: an old red home telephone with a curly cord on a little table in the hall.
more: Grandma answers the telephone.
奶奶接电话。
The telephone is in the kitchen.
电话在厨房里。

words.en: Tom watches a funny video.
words.sz: Tom 看一个有趣的视频。
words.scene: Tom and Lily watching a funny dog video on a tablet.
more: Lily makes a video of Max.
Lily 给 Max 录了一个视频。
We share the video with Sam.
我们和 Sam 分享这个视频。
